one_liner: Telegram offers a free HTTPS Bot API (bot token from @BotFather) plus the MTProto user API (api_id); easy to build on, with only third-party community MCP servers (no vendor MCP).
auth_notes: Bot API: each bot gets a static authentication token used in the URL path (API_KEY). MTProto user API uses phone-based user authorization, 2FA SRP and a registered application id (OTHER). No OAuth 2.0 for delegated API access is shown in the pages, so OAUTH2 is not listed.
access_notes: The Telegram docs state both the Bot API and the Telegram API are free to use. Bot tokens are issued on bot creation. The Gateway API is a separate product and is not needed for the core API.
blocker_notes: Bot tokens are per-bot, so each customer needs their own bot. Community MCP servers acting as a userbot run under a personal account via MTProto, which may carry account risk (ToS pages were not provided, so this is unverified).
